title: Prism Coins
summary: **Prism Coins** (⛃) are ChromaPVP's currency. You earn them by playing and spend them on FFA kits and upgrades, stash pages, cosmetics and crates.

ul: **Duels:** an unranked win pays 15 and a loss 5. A ranked win pays 30 and a loss 10.
**FFA:** 5 a kill, plus 5 more on every fifth kill of a streak. Coin Charms add to each kill. See [FFA](/wiki/pvp/ffa/).
**Arena:** 180, 120, 75 or 30 for your final placement, and 5 for each enemy you knock out. See [Arena](/wiki/pvp/arena/).
**Parkour:** your first finish of the spawn parkour each day pays 25.
**FFA events:** Double Prism Coins doubles kills, duels and the Arena while it runs. The Golden Loot Slime pays for the damage you deal it.
**Tournaments:** the top three places pay Prism Coins. See [Tournaments](/wiki/pvp/tournaments/).

blocks.p: Every reward shows in chat as it lands, for example **+⛃ 15 Prism Coins**.

ul: **Supplies** (the Supplies NPC on the FFA platform, or `/ffa shop`): FFA kits, the eight-step gear upgrade track and extra stash pages.
**Cosmetics** (`/cosmetics`): kill effects, trails, hats, titles and more. See [Crates and Cosmetics](/wiki/pvp/crates/).
**Crates** (`/crates`): the Spectrum, Mythic and Arsenal Crates.

blocks.p: On the Supplies screen you click twice to buy, so one stray click spends nothing. If a purchase fails, no Prism Coins are taken.

PVP Membership adds 5% to the Prism Coins you earn by playing, rounded down. The reward line in chat shows the bonus as **(Member +N)**. The bonus does not apply to tournament prizes. Members also get a purple name.

ul: Ranked pays twice what unranked does, win or lose.
Plan around the FFA event timer. Double Prism Coins comes around once in every four events.
Kills on the same player stop paying after three in 10 minutes, so move on to new targets.
